title: Audit event taxonomy and delta-capture contract for admin config changes and SSO-mapped actors
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a single, compact, forward-compatible audit event contract that captures: (1) who performed admin or privileged configuration changes (actor resolution for SSO/SAML identities and service principals), (2) what changed (field-level deltas), (3) where the change applied (resource/target), and (4) rich contextual telemetry (request id, client IP, region, auth method) while enabling redaction, sampling, and efficient storage. This spec focuses on the delta payload encoding, actor canonicalization rules (SSO/SAML mapping, SCIM, service tokens), and a taxonomy for event types used by RBAC v2 and admin control surfaces. Deliverables: canonical schema text, example event payloads for common flows (UI admin role change, API key rotation, SAML metadata upload), storage/retention guidance, and an integration checklist for Console and Private control plane ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: A JSON schema (draft-07 compatible) exists for audit events including core fields: event_id, ts, event_type, actor, target, delta, context, and schema_version.
Three example events present: (1) role grant via SSO (mapped user), (2) RBAC policy change by service account, (3) sensitive config roll-back with multi-field diff.
Actor resolution rules documented: mapping precedence (SAML assertion > SCIM user > local account > service token) and canonical id generation rules for cross-plane correlation.
Delta encoding defined as a compact list of atomic field edits supporting ops: add, remove, replace, merge, and annotate. Backward/forward compatibility notes provided.
Specification includes redaction strategy (field-level redaction keys and hashing), sampling guidelines (when to store full diffs vs compact frames), and retention-class mapping for each event_type.
Console ingestion tests: Console shows event timeline with before/after views and links to PR/Change ticket for events with external references.
Security review sign-off recorded and threat modeling notes attached.
Integration checklist for Dedicated and Private deployments that require local KMS/HSM use for redaction keys and offline audit export.
Unit tests or fakes for the runtime event canonicalizer to validate actor canonicalization permutations.

Performance budget: serialized event size for typical admin change (<= 1.2KB) and worst-case multi-field change (<= 8KB) without full diff expansion; storage estimates provided for 12 months at projected event rates.

Create 3 canonical example payloads (SSO user grant, service account policy edit, API key rotate) and attach to ticket
Define actor canonicalization algorithm and implement pseudocode in spec
Design compact delta format (compact-changeframe) and provide serializer/deserializer reference
Define redaction and hashing rules for PII and secrets; coordinate with security team for KMS requirements
Add sampling/retention mapping and cost estimate for runtime and cold storage
Add console UI rendering requirements and API contract for timeline/detail view
Run review with Security and Privacy (security_review_required=true) and incorporate feedback
Add end-to-end ingestion test plan for Private deployment with offline KMS keys
notes: We must avoid duplicating legacy audit payload shapes; prioritize compactness and de-duplication for repeated actor/target references.
This contract will be consumed by: control-plane write path, console timeline renderer, long-term audit indexer, and change-fallback/rollback automation.
Retention classes: ephemeral (30d), standard (1y), legal (7y) — each maps to different redaction/expansion rules.
Cross-linking: events should support a small list of external references (git PR, Linear key, incident ID) to help audits and postmortems.
Consider adding an incremental compression scheme for long diffs (e.g., protocol buffers delta + gzip) for long-run storage.
We will default to storing compact diffs; full previous state snapshots only for high-sensitivity resources where retention policy requires it.
decision_log: 2025-02-20: Chose compact list-of-edits delta representation over full object snapshots to reduce storage and make diffs queryable (decided by Security + Infra).
2025-02-25: Actor mapping precedence approved: SAML assertion -> SCIM -> local user -> service principal; canonical id format: <provider>:<opaque-hash> for cross-plane joins.
2025-03-03: Redaction will use deterministic hashing for PII (sha256 + per-tenant salt stored in KMS) instead of irreversible truncation to support fuzzy joins when permitted.
2025-03-04: Retention classes finalized and mapped to default sampling thresholds for non-production tenants.
example_payloads:
-- example 1: SSO user role grant (UI) --
{
  "event_id": "evt_20250304_0001",
  "ts": "2025-03-04T15:12:23Z",
  "event_type": "rbac.role.grant",
  "schema_version": "audit.v2",
  "actor": "saml:google-oauth2:U_9a3f5b2",
  "actor_profile": "user:alice@example.com",
  "target": "org:acme:policy:1234",
  "delta": [
    {"op": "add", "path": "/roles/", "value": "admin"}
  ],
  "context": "req:abc-123 ip:203.0.113.7 region:us-west1"
}
integration_checklist: Add schema validation to control-plane write path and fail fast with clear error codes for non-conformant events.
Expose a per-tenant salt KMS key for deterministic PII hashing; document rotation procedure.
Console: implement timeline rendering with expandable diff view and masked sensitive values by default.
Dedicated/Private: include instructions for configuring local KMS/HSM and verifying redaction behavior during ingest tests.
Indexer: ensure delta queries can be run to find changes to specific fields across events (e.g., all changes to /roles/).
Backups: plan for periodic rehydration tests where full snapshots are reconstructed from deltas + occasional snapshots.
